scope: OpenSwiftUI View architecture adapted for synchronous Embedded Swift, with LVGL integration isolated in LVGLRendererAdaptor
changes: Keep App -> View and omit Scene for the single permanent display
Omit AttributeGraph, _GraphValue, graph invalidation, runtime field reflection and dynamic tuple metadata
Retain upstream View construction names and add compile-time _makeProperties registration in place of runtime field reflection
Use _ViewInputs, _ViewOutputs, _ViewListInputs, _ViewListOutputs, _ViewListCountInputs and ViewList for synchronous construction
Resolve short-lived construction commands into DisplayList.Item values with frame, identity, version and local transaction before LVGL mounting
Match ViewModifier, PrimitiveViewModifier, UnaryViewModifier, MultiViewModifier, _ViewModifier_Content and ModifiedContent composition
Implement typed EnvironmentValues keys, Environment and _EnvironmentKeyWritingModifier as synchronous inherited inputs
Implement Animatable, GeometryEffect, _RendererEffect and RendererEffect without graph-backed interpolation
Use non-generic LayoutSubviews and LayoutSubview proxies with the upstream Layout method names and integer embedded geometry
Keep ViewTraitCollection synchronous with concrete Any-valued entries because Embedded Swift cannot invoke generic existential requirements
Use a statically typed _ViewPair with immutable shared storage and buildPartialBlock because Embedded Swift cannot reflect tuple metadata
Keep _ViewInputs compact with copy-on-write inherited storage to bound recursive stack use without sharing mutable branch values

Retain identity scopes as nested display-list commands, parse and mount with explicit frame stacks, and pass a lightweight metrics provider so updates do not copy command arrays, recurse through large RISC-V frames, or clone renderer dictionaries
Keep eager List and ScrollView; implement keyed ForEach<Data, ID, Content> and IDView without row recycling
Move the display-list renderer, LVGL backend, font resolution, physical input, timers, animation execution and screenshots into LVGLRendererAdaptor
Coalesce queued physical-button state changes into one render, keep scroll-only input in place, and use native Circle clipping plus bounded analytic ellipse masks to stay within the fixed LVGL pool
Use adaptor-supplied rendering limits and defaults, initially 64 nodes and 16 container levels, with identity-based scroll and lifecycle state
Generate State, Binding and Environment registration on the build host with SwiftSyntax; retain installed locations across child body reconstruction
Use proposal-aware core layout proxies, explicit alignment guides, ViewSpacing and stack orientation; place through an explicit work stack
Retain typed DynamicPropertyBox update/reset/destroy phases, IDPhase and phase-driven appearance transitions without AttributeGraph
Separate display instance identities from stable identity scopes with committed ownership and rollback of uncommitted instances
Expose eager ViewList element IDs, trait keys, iterator granularity, concrete sublist traversal, explicit-ID offsets and one-update edit snapshots
Install each composed modifier through a shared entry point; bind State projections to their original location and retain per-host pending transactions
Require adaptor-supplied implicit root layout and use only representable numeric ranges in portable geometry
Preserve native LVGL animation time and repeat phase when stable identity and model target are unchanged
Keep omitted graph/preferences/lazy ViewList and archived renderer-effect APIs explicit; reject unsupported negative scale/reflection instead of silently hiding content
Preserve adaptor-selected implicit roots in unary and custom modifier list conversion without allocating extra nodes for known unary content
Pin State body captures to value-local installations while retaining root handles and stale Binding protection
Allocate stack space by priority group after reserving lower-priority minimum sizes
Keep animation timing composition in seconds; LVGLRendererAdaptor owns millisecond quantization, native arithmetic limits and repeat-count encoding
Share one eager row-expansion budget across nested and sibling ForEach construction, including empty rows, and stop after exhaustion

EmbeddedAlignment.swift.adaptation: Use compact typed AlignmentID resolvers with integer guide values instead of runtime alignment-key metadata.

EmbeddedBackground.swift.adaptation: Use the upstream _BackgroundModifier ownership model and emit synchronous DisplayList content.

EmbeddedColor.swift.adaptation: Keep system colors as semantic tokens resolved by adaptor-supplied SystemColorDefinition; retain explicit constant sRGB components.

EmbeddedFrame.swift.adaptation: Use the upstream _FrameLayout modifier name with bounded integer-pixel dimensions.

EmbeddedHStack.swift.adaptation: Emit a synchronous DisplayList while retaining the upstream HStack and HStackLayout roles.

EmbeddedImage.swift.adaptation: Carry the image name and resizing policy to the adaptor's asset resolver and proposal-aware layout.

EmbeddedLayout.swift.adaptation: Retain Layout measurement, placement, spacing, orientation and explicit-guide callbacks with compact shared callback storage and integer geometry.

EmbeddedLayoutSubviews.swift.adaptation: Use non-generic synchronous proxies for measurement, placement, dimensions and spacing; retain the placement proposal explicitly.

EmbeddedLayoutView.swift.adaptation: Emit a Layout description measured by core proxies with adaptor-provided text/image metrics before mounting.

EmbeddedOffset.swift.adaptation: Use the upstream _OffsetEffect GeometryEffect role and defer integer rounding to the platform renderer.

EmbeddedOptionalView.swift.adaptation: Select the present branch synchronously through _makeView and _makeViewList.

EmbeddedPadding.swift.adaptation: Use the upstream _PaddingLayout modifier name with bounded integer-pixel insets.

EmbeddedPhysicalButton.swift.adaptation: Keep logical board input and its modifier in LVGLRendererAdaptor and emit a generic ViewResponder through _ViewOutputs.

EmbeddedProposedViewSize.swift.adaptation: Use Int32 representable infinity for public proposals; renderer-supplied coordinate limits bound actual stack probes and mounting.

EmbeddedRenderSink.swift.omitted: The synchronous sink duplicates View layout and rendering responsibilities; DisplayList is the sole portable output.

EmbeddedSize.swift.adaptation: Use a stored static constant for the zero size.

EmbeddedStackLayout.swift.adaptation: Use non-generic LayoutSubview proxies and _StackLayoutCache with integer priority-group allocation and reserved lower-priority minima.

EmbeddedState.swift.adaptation: Install State through typed lifecycle boxes and compile-time fields, pin State body captures and Binding to their installed location and propagate Binding transactions.

EmbeddedText.swift.adaptation: Preserve String initializers and resolve inherited EnvironmentValues into short-lived DisplayList text content.

EmbeddedVStack.swift.adaptation: Emit a synchronous DisplayList while retaining the upstream VStack and VStackLayout roles.

EmbeddedViewHost.swift.adaptation: Retain ViewGraph state locations by structural and explicit identity; commit ownership after successful mounting and invalidate removed bindings.

EmbeddedViewPair.swift.adaptation: Use a statically typed _ViewPair with immutable shared child storage to avoid descendant-value copies on recursive call frames.

EmbeddedZStack.swift.adaptation: Emit synchronous overlay DisplayList content; LVGLRendererAdaptor applies stable zIndex ordering.

adaptations: Caller-owned scene instead of global page state
Caller-provided static image resolver instead of the application-specific spark asset
Preserve the mounted scene on failure and invalidate for retry
Build a short-lived DisplayList and consume it synchronously in LVGLRendererAdaptor
Implement scene, shape, animation, bitmap font selection and screenshots in Swift; retain only imported constants and the screenshot C ABI declaration in HeaderBridge.h
Map reference Embedded filenames to unprefixed local filenames and record synchronous functional adaptations
